title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Perk: Completion Percent Raised by Net Registry Rewards
content:
A Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry whose guests' gifts have built up registry rewards earns its registrant a completion registry perk on the completion discount the registrant redeems on her or his own order line (a purchase record of a registry item still in ordered status). The perk is added to the line's completion percent in percentage points and follows the registry's **net registry rewards**: the total of its registry rewards accrual entries less the total of its registry rewards reversal entries.

| Net registry rewards of the registry | Perk added |
|---|---|
| at least USD 550.00 (the upper perk threshold) | 4 percentage points |
| at least USD 300.00 (the lower perk threshold) but below USD 550.00 | 2 percentage points |
| below USD 300.00 | none |

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical balances)

| Accrual entries total | Reversal entries total | Net registry rewards | Perk |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 600.00 | USD 50.00 | USD 550.00 | 4 |
| USD 600.00 | USD 50.01 | USD 549.99 | 2 |
| USD 340.00 | USD 40.00 | USD 300.00 | 2 |
| USD 340.00 | USD 40.01 | USD 299.99 | none |

### Basis Q&A

**Is the perk read from the registry rewards paid out?** No. It is read from the registry's accrual entries less its reversal entries.

**Does a reversal entry lower the perk?** Yes; every reversal entry is subtracted from the accrual entries before the thresholds are applied.
